Fourth version of the Hexagon preprint https://hexagonmath.org/2610.00471v3 (amsart, single column, 31 pages).

Two theorems are new. Theorem 5.12 (Section 5.4) shows that the conditions of the Main Theorem are sufficient when the residual dimension is ten: a complex isometry that keeps the total dimension and the rank of the null frame carries Nishino's equations to every signature with s+t-2k = 10 and s-t in {8, 0, -8}, and the transported theory keeps a Majorana-Weyl gaugino and satisfies N1-N5. By Corollary 5.13 a theory with residual dimension at least three exists exactly when the Main Theorem allows it; in particular in 9+9 and 9+17, and in no member 9+(1+8n) with n >= 3. Theorem 7.3 (Section 7.2) drops N4 and allows any fixed tensor u in the source J ^ u that absorbs the cubic gaugino terms, with or without a gaugino constraint: the residual dimension is then at most 14, and at most 10 unless the frame has rank at least 54. By Corollary 7.4 no contraction of the source rescues the families (9+8n)+1, (10+8n)+2, (11+8n)+3, (12+8n)+4 with n >= 1, including 27+3 and 19+3; this covers the spacelike contraction left open in a footnote of v3. Appendix E checks both theorems in explicit gamma matrices (`verification/code/contraction_check.py`, 32 checks, log in `verification/current/contraction-checks.txt`); Figures 7 and 11 are drawn by `verification/code/figures/make_v4_figures.py`.

Citations of unrefereed preprints were removed: the arXiv paper of Truini, Marrani and Rios is replaced by its published version (Expo. Math. 43 (2025) 125621, with de Graaf), and the arXiv preprint of Banerjee and two self-archived copies of earlier versions are no longer cited. Existence for residual dimension two and theories outside N1-N5 are not decided.

Files: `NullProjectedSYM_v4-tex.zip` (the source to upload; main.tex, pdfLaTeX; the Python programs in `anc/`), `NullProjectedSYM_v4.pdf`, `NullProjectedSYM_v4-arxiv.tar.gz`, `HEXAGON_FORM.md` and `AI_PROVENANCE.md`. The source compiles with `pdflatex -jobname=output main.tex` with no errors, no bad boxes and no undefined references. `scripts/verify.py` (34 checks), `transfer_check.py` (24 checks) and `contraction_check.py` (32 checks) pass.
